title: pH-dependent redox hydrogen pump for electrochemical direct air capture of CO2
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,3623-3629
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09310D, Paper
Open Access

Xiangyu Zhang, Yun Zhao, Yangkai Han, Zhiwei Ren, Tao Wei, Riyang Huang, Zhigang Shao
This work addresses a critical challenge in dual-electrolyzer systems for direct air capture of CO2 (DAC): a new electrochemical DAC strategy utilizing a pH-dependent redox mediator to achieve low-energy CO2 capture.
